name: upsert_application_events
description: Persist validated compact internship application status events. Never send raw email bodies or OAuth data.

events.description: One or more validated application events.

message_id.description: Provider message ID used only for hashing and idempotency.

evidence_summary.description: Short non-sensitive status evidence; never a full body.

name: get_application_statuses
description: Get the latest chronologically valid status for every known internship application.

name: export_daily_application_excel
description: Create a private formatted Excel snapshot of every application status and return a short-lived download URL.

name: get_sync_checkpoint
description: Read the last successful incremental sync checkpoint for Gmail or Outlook.

name: update_sync_checkpoint
description: Update a provider checkpoint only after all messages through that checkpoint were processed successfully.

name: gmail_connection_status
description: Check whether the demo user's Gmail account has granted delegated read-only access.

name: gmail_begin_authorization
description: Create a short-lived Google consent URL for delegated Gmail read-only access. Never request a password.

name: gmail_scan_application_emails
description: Search and retrieve a compact chronological batch of internship-related Gmail messages using delegated read-only access. Attachments are never fetched and message bodies are not persisted.

query.description: Optional Gmail search query. Defaults to internship application and status terms from the last year.
